sourcing.caseStudies: https://www.lwblive.com/successstories serves 72 redacted wealth plan crops as plain static files at exactly 920px wide. There is no srcset, no resize query parameter, and no larger variant (case-006-full, @2x, .png and /full/ and /originals/ paths all return 404), so 920px is the original. The three already in this repo were byte-identical to the source.
sourcing.videoThumbnails: Vimeo oEmbed returns a _1280 thumbnail URL; swapping the suffix to _1920 returns the full-resolution frame. Those were downscaled to 1600px wide and encoded as WebP at quality 82.
sourcing.reEncoding: Case study files were copied verbatim rather than re-encoded. They are already WebP and under the 1600px cap, so a second lossy pass would have lost quality without saving bytes.
